widgets_values: A black-haired young woman in a black-and-white maid outfit stands on a sunlit outdoor basketball court, holding a basketball with both hands and looking into the camera. She smiles softly, then turns around and dribbles the ball twice, jogging forward into a quick breakthrough move. Her skirt hem and hair sway naturally in the breeze. She finishes with a light jump and a one-handed basketball shot, the ball flying toward the hoop. Fresh, bright, clean cinematic atmosphere, soft sunlight, realistic motion. The camera starts in a medium close-up, follows her movement forward, gradually widening to a full-body shot, and freezes on the moment of release.
